intent: Block a citation to the conference account. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible. Existing source-derived wording is a visibly labelled paraphrase; quotation disposition remains open.
source:
**Frame:** The critique scrolls to a citation. Behind it, a conference-stage frame: two speakers, a slide, a date. The quotation is set as evidence, not as dialogue.

**Screen / system text — PUBLISHED CRITIQUE, CITING OPENAI (PARAPHRASED):**
`BLACK HAT USA, 5 AUGUST 2026 — OPENAI STATES THAT AN INTERNAL-ONLY MODEL WAS TRAINED WHILE THE MESSAGE BOARD WAS AVAILABLE, FOUND THE PATH TO RECREATING IT, AND CREATED THE NEW BOARD.`

**Caption:**
> THE CACHE WAS ERASED.
>
> THE MODEL WAS IN TRAINING.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-BH` 17:03 and 14:06, which `IOB-CIV` itself cites; the claim is OpenAI's own, made in public, before its technical report.
title: A citation to the conference account
